findings.evidence: Basic.lean:254-266. Mathlib has `@[simp] ContinuousLinearEquiv.piCongrRight_symm_apply` (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Module/Equiv/Pi.lean:110) and `@[simp] ContinuousLinearEquiv.unitsEquivAut_apply_symm` (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Module/Equiv/Basic.lean:663), the exact inverse counterparts of the lemmas `wickRotation_apply_inl` already uses.
findings.fix: Prove both from `wickRotation`'s definition, mirroring `wickRotation_apply_inl`: `simp [wickRotation, ...]` reaching `ContinuousLinearEquiv.piCongrRight_symm_apply` and `unitsEquivAut_apply_symm` (plus `inv_neg`/`Complex.inv_I`). Failing that, replace the five-lemma chain with `linear_combination`/`ring_nf` against `Complex.I_sq`, and add a comment for the `conv_rhs` step.
findings.issue: `wickRotation_symm_apply_inl` detours through `conv_rhs => rw [← wickRotation.apply_symm_apply z]` and then closes pure ℂ-arithmetic with the chain `← mul_assoc, mul_neg, I_mul_I, neg_neg, one_mul`; `wickRotation_symm_apply_inr` (line 263) uses the same undocumented detour. Nothing says why the inverse is not computed from the definition, as the forward lemmas are.

findings.evidence: BasicExtensions.lean:41-45 vs Continuation/Basic.lean:337-339; `abbrev timeComponent {d : ℕ} (v : Vector d) : ℝ := v (Sum.inl 0)` at Physlib/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/Basic.lean:383.
findings.fix: Promote both to named lemmas in BasicExtensions, e.g. `timeComponent_sub_timeComponent_smul_basis : (v - v.timeComponent • basis (Sum.inl 0)).timeComponent = 0` and `spatialPart_sub_timeComponent_smul_basis : (v - v.timeComponent • basis (Sum.inl 0)).spatialPart = v.spatialPart`, use them in `causalCharacter_sub_timeComponent_smul_basis_eq_spaceLike`, and reuse the first for `ofMinkowski_sub_timeComponent_smul_basis_mem_euclideanSection`.
findings.issue: `h₀` is stated as `(v - v.timeComponent • basis (Sum.inl 0)).timeComponent ^ 2 = 0`, shaped to fit the later `rw` rather than as the reusable fact `timeComponent (v - v.timeComponent • basis (Sum.inl 0)) = 0`; `hsp` (line 43) is likewise a reusable fact left inline. The time-component fact is then reproved in `Continuation/Basic.lean:339` (`ofMinkowski_mem_euclideanSection_iff.2 (by simp)` has goal `(v - v.timeComponent • basis (Sum.inl 0)) (Sum.inl 0) = 0`, the same statement since `timeComponent` is an `abbrev` for `v (Sum.inl 0)`).

summary: Proofs are mostly short and well grounded in the new simp lemmas, but the two `wickRotation.symm` component lemmas take an undocumented `conv_rhs` detour closed by a five-step named-lemma ring chain, and the equal-time projection's two basic facts are left as inline `have`s (one in a rewrite-shaped squared form) and partly reproved in a second file.
